error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a who-unlocked bridge at that URL. Check the bridge is running and the host and port are correct.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http(s) URL, for example http://mac-mini.local:8787.

user.description: Enter the URL of the who-unlocked bridge running on your Mac Mini. The bridge listens to eufy push notifications and serves the latest unlock over HTTP; Home Assistant polls it. No eufy account details are needed here — the bridge holds the eufy session.
user.title: Connect to the eufy Who Unlocked bridge
